ruleDefinitions.name: Arbitrary Binary Execution Using GUP Utility
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the Notepad++ updater (gup) to launch other commands or executables

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\gup\\\.exe$") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Notepad\\+\\+\\\\notepad\\+\\+\\\.exe.*")) OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Notepad\\+\\+\\\\updater\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = "None")
